title: THE TEAMMATE KIT CARD SAYS THE PARTY GOES UP
why: Found by the whole-game bug hunt of 2026-10-08. In co-op, when the host goes up, his teammate is asked what he is taking up. If the teammate pressed Not yet to buy a Medkit first (B on a controller, ESC and TAB press it too), nothing told the host, and about 15 seconds later the party went up anyway and pulled him out of the Undercroft with whatever was packed. The host still takes everyone up, as before. The teammate card now reads PARTY IS GOING UP with the seconds left before he goes up with the kit he has, and its way out reads KEEP MY KIT, which is what it does. The host card and the Hire nobody card still say Not yet.
now: In co-op, the kit question tells a teammate the party goes up without him answering, and its way out reads KEEP MY KIT.
